; Isolated Lesson07. Only named teaching coupon/board may be edited.
procedure(l7Setup(libDir)
  axlDBChangeDesignUnits("millimeters" 3)
  unless(equal(axlDBGetDesignUnits() list("millimeters" 3)) error("Wrong units\n"))
  unless(axlDBChangeDesignExtents(list(-20.0:-15.0 20.0:15.0)) error("Extents failed\n"))
  axlSetVariable("padpath" list(libDir))
  axlSetVariable("psmpath" list(libDir))
)
procedure(l7CreatePackage(libDir outDir)
  let((f style text p result bound saved compiled cases c)
    unless(equal(axlCurrentDesign() "eda_l07_padstack_coupon") error("Wrong package name\n"))
    unless(length(axlDBGetDesign()->pins)==0 error("Not empty\n"))
    l7Setup(libDir)
    f=outfile(strcat(outDir "/create.txt"))
    fprintf(f "L07_PACKAGE_CREATE START\nunits=%L\n" axlDBGetDesignUnits())
    style=make_axlTextOrientation(?textBlock "2" ?rotation 0.0 ?mirrored nil ?justify "center")
    cases=list(
      list("eda_l07_pth_080_c160" -5.0:4.0 "1" 0.0)
      list("eda_l07_pth_080_c160" 5.0:4.0 "2" 90.0)
      list("eda_l07_npth_200_ring" -5.0:0.0 nil 0.0)
      list("eda_l07_npth_200_ring" 5.0:0.0 nil 90.0)
      list("eda_l07_plated_slot_200x100" -5.0:-4.0 "5" 0.0)
      list("eda_l07_plated_slot_200x100" 5.0:-4.0 "6" 90.0))
    foreach(c cases
      p=axlLoadPadstack(car(c))
      unless(p error("Padstack load failed\n"))
      text=nil
      when(caddr(c) text=make_axlPinText(?number caddr(c) ?offset 0:0 ?text style))
      result=axlDBCreatePin(p cadr(c) text cadddr(c))
      unless(result error("Pin create failed\n"))
      fprintf(f "pin=%L xy=%L rotation=%L mechanical=%L drc=%L\n"
        car(result)->number car(result)->xy car(result)->rotation car(result)->isMech cadr(result)))
    unless(length(axlDBGetDesign()->pins)==6 error("Wrong created pin count\n"))
    result=axlDBCreateRectangle(list(-7.0:-6.0 7.0:6.0) t "PACKAGE GEOMETRY/PLACE_BOUND_TOP" nil nil)
    unless(result error("Bound failed\n"))
    bound=car(result)
    unless(axlDBAddProp(list(bound) list("PACKAGE_HEIGHT_MAX" "1 MM")) error("Height failed\n"))
    foreach(layer list("REF DES/SILKSCREEN_TOP" "REF DES/ASSEMBLY_TOP")
      unless(axlDBCreateText("U*" 0:0 style layer nil) error("Refdes failed\n")))
    unless(axlDBCreateText("VALUE" 0:0 style "COMPONENT VALUE/ASSEMBLY_TOP" nil) error("Value failed\n"))
    saved=axlSaveDesign(?design strcat(libDir "/eda_l07_padstack_coupon.dra") ?noMru t ?noConfirm t)
    unless(saved error("Save failed\n"))
    compiled=axlCompileSymbol(?symbol strcat(libDir "/eda_l07_padstack_coupon"))
    unless(compiled error("Compile failed\n"))
    fprintf(f "saved=%L compiled=%L\nL07_PACKAGE_CREATE COMPLETE\n" saved compiled)
    close(f)
    t))
procedure(l7CreateBoard(libDir outDir)
  let((f xs definition result saved)
    unless(equal(axlCurrentDesign() "eda_l07_mapping_4layer") error("Wrong board name\n"))
    unless(length(axlDBGetDesign()->symbols)==0 error("Not an empty board\n"))
    l7Setup(libDir)
    f=outfile(strcat(outDir "/create.txt"))
    fprintf(f "L07_BOARD_CREATE START\n")
    foreach(name list("L2" "L3")
      definition=axlXSectionModify(?name name ?layerType "CONDUCTOR" ?material "COPPER" ?thickness 0.035)
      xs=axlXSectionCreate(nil 'bottom definition)
      unless(xs error("Cannot add conductor layer\n"))
      definition=axlXSectionModify(?layerType "DIELECTRIC" ?material "FR-4" ?thickness 0.4)
      xs=axlXSectionCreate(nil 'bottom definition)
      unless(xs error("Cannot add dielectric layer\n")))
    foreach(xs axlXSectionGet(nil 'all)
      when(equal(xs->layerType "DIELECTRIC")
        unless(axlXSectionSet(xs axlXSectionModify(?thickness 0.4)) error("Cannot set dielectric\n"))))
    result=axlDBCreateSymbol(list("eda_l07_padstack_coupon" "PACKAGE") 0:0 nil 0.0)
    unless(result error("Cannot place isolated package\n"))
    unless(length(car(result)->pins)==6 error("Wrong placed pin count\n"))
    fprintf(f "symbol=%L pins=%d drc=%L\n" car(result)->name length(car(result)->pins) cadr(result))
    saved=axlSaveDesign(?design strcat(libDir "/eda_l07_mapping_4layer.brd") ?noMru t ?noConfirm t)
    unless(saved error("Cannot save board\n"))
    fprintf(f "saved=%L\nL07_BOARD_CREATE COMPLETE\n" saved)
    close(f)
    t))
procedure(l7AllPins()
  let((pins sym)
    pins=axlDBGetDesign()->pins
    unless(pins
      foreach(sym axlDBGetDesign()->symbols pins=append(pins sym->pins)))
    pins))
procedure(l7PadRow(f pin layer kind)
  let((pad box w h)
    pad=axlDBGetPad(pin layer kind)
    box=if(pad then pad->bBox else nil)
    w=if(box then car(cadr(box))-car(car(box)) else nil)
    h=if(box then cadr(cadr(box))-cadr(car(box)) else nil)
    fprintf(f "%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\n"
      pin->name pin->number car(pin->xy) cadr(pin->xy) pin->rotation
      layer kind if(pad then pad->figureName else nil) w h box)))
procedure(l7Read(outDir)
  let((report pf df sf xf af pins pin ps pad layer kind layers xs polys poly bbox)
    report=outfile(strcat(outDir "/verify.txt"))
    pf=outfile(strcat(outDir "/pins.tsv"))
    df=outfile(strcat(outDir "/pads.tsv"))
    sf=outfile(strcat(outDir "/padstacks.tsv"))
    xf=outfile(strcat(outDir "/stackup.tsv"))
    af=outfile(strcat(outDir "/polygons.tsv"))
    unless(report && pf && df && sf && xf && af error("Cannot open readback files\n"))
    fprintf(report "L07_READ START\ndesign=%L type=%L units=%L\n" axlCurrentDesign() axlDesignType(t) axlDBGetDesignUnits())
    fprintf(report "stored_drcs=%d drc_state=%L\n" length(axlDBGetDesign()->drcs) axlDBGetDesign()->drcState)
    fprintf(pf "padstack\tnumber\tx\ty\trotation\tmechanical\tthrough\thole_type\tplating\tdrill_diameter\tdrill_x\tdrill_y\tstart_end\n")
    fprintf(df "padstack\tnumber\tx\ty\trotation\tlayer\tkind\tfigure\twidth\theight\tbbox\n")
    fprintf(sf "padstack\tusage\thole_type\tplating\tdrill_diameter\tdrill_x\tdrill_y\tdrill_offset\tthrough\tstart_end\tplating_api\n")
    fprintf(xf "name\tlayer_type\tmaterial\tthickness\tconductor\tnegative_artwork\n")
    fprintf(af "padstack\tnumber\tx\ty\trotation\tlayer\tindex\tbbox\tarea\tvertices\n")
    layers=list("ETCH/TOP" "ETCH/BOTTOM")
    foreach(xs axlXSectionGet(nil 'all)
      fprintf(xf "%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\n" xs->name xs->layerType xs->material xs->thickness xs->conductor xs->negativeArtwork)
      when(member(xs->name list("L2" "L3"))
        layers=append(layers list(strcat("ETCH/" xs->name)))))
    pins=l7AllPins()
    unless(length(pins)==6 error("Expected six pins\n"))
    foreach(ps axlDBGetDesign()->padstacks
      fprintf(sf "%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\n"
        ps->name ps->usage ps->holeType ps->plating ps->drillDiameter ps->drillSizeWidth ps->drillSizeHeight
        ps->drillOffset ps->isThrough ps->startEnd axlDBGetDrillPlating(ps->name)))
    foreach(pin pins
      ps=pin->definition
      fprintf(pf "%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\n"
        pin->name pin->number car(pin->xy) cadr(pin->xy) pin->rotation pin->isMech pin->isThrough
        ps->holeType ps->plating ps->drillDiameter ps->drillSizeWidth ps->drillSizeHeight pin->startEnd)
      foreach(layer layers
        foreach(kind list("REGULAR" "ANTI" "THERMAL" "KEEPOUT") l7PadRow(df pin layer kind))
        polys=axlPolyFromDB(pin ?layer layer ?padType 'REGULAR)
        foreach(poly polys
          fprintf(af "%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%L\t%d\t%L\t%L\t%L\n"
            pin->name pin->number car(pin->xy) cadr(pin->xy) pin->rotation layer 1 poly->bBox poly->area poly->vertices)))
      foreach(layer list("PIN/SOLDERMASK_TOP" "PIN/SOLDERMASK_BOTTOM" "PIN/PASTEMASK_TOP" "PIN/PASTEMASK_BOTTOM")
        l7PadRow(df pin layer "REGULAR"))
      foreach(kind list("REGULAR" "ANTI" "THERMAL" "KEEPOUT")
        pad=axlDBGetPad(ps 'internal kind)
        bbox=if(pad then pad->bBox else nil)
        fprintf(report "DEFAULT_INTERNAL padstack=%L kind=%L figure=%L bbox=%L\n"
          ps->name kind if(pad then pad->figureName else nil) bbox)))
    fprintf(report "pins=%d queried_etch_layers=%L\nL07_READ COMPLETE\n" length(pins) layers)
    foreach(f list(report pf df sf xf af) close(f))
    t))

"""Independent comparison of persisted Allegro readback against teaching spec.
No CAD modifications. Ring NPTH is not a bare or plated hole.
"""
import csv,json,pathlib,re,sys,hashlib,math
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec=json.loads((root/"lesson07_spec_v4.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
problems=[]
checks=[]
def check(ok,msg):
    checks.append({"ok":bool(ok),"check":msg})
    if not ok: problems.append(msg)
def rows(p):
    with p.open(encoding="utf-8-sig",newline="") as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t"))
def num(v):
    if v in ("nil","",None):return None
    return float(v)
def norm(v):return re.sub("[^a-z0-9]","",str(v).lower())
def near(a,b):return a is not None and math.isclose(float(a),float(b),abs_tol=1e-6,rel_tol=0)
def dim(kind,p):
    return p[{"REGULAR":"regular","ANTI":"anti","THERMAL":"thermal","KEEPOUT":"keepout"}[kind]]
def case_for(row):
    for c in spec["cases"]:
        p=spec["padstacks"][c["pad"]]
        if row["padstack"].lower()==p["name"] and near(num(row["x"]),c["xy"][0]) and near(num(row["y"]),c["xy"][1]):
            return c,p
    return None,None
def expected_figure(figure,xy):
    if xy is None:return figure in ("nil","NULL","",None)
    return figure not in ("nil","NULL","",None)
def numbers(v):return [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?",v)]
summary={}
for run in ["reopen_package","reopen_board"]:
    d=root/"logs"/run
    text=(d/"verify.txt").read_text()
    check("L07_READ COMPLETE" in text,run+" completed")
    check('units=("millimeters" 3)' in text,run+" mm accuracy 3")
    pinrows=rows(d/"pins.tsv")
    padrows=rows(d/"pads.tsv")
    psrows=rows(d/"padstacks.tsv")
    stack=rows(d/"stackup.tsv")
    polyrows=rows(d/"polygons.tsv")
    check(len(pinrows)==6,run+" six pins")
    check(len(psrows)==3,run+" three accepted padstacks")
    seen=set()
    for row in pinrows:
        c,p=case_for(row)
        check(c is not None,run+" expected pin position/name "+str(row))
        if c is None:continue
        seen.add(c["id"])
        check(near(num(row["rotation"]),c["rotation"]),run+" "+c["id"]+" rotation")
        check((row["mechanical"]=="t")==c["mechanical"],run+" "+c["id"]+" mechanical status")
        check(row["through"]=="t",run+" "+c["id"]+" geometric through span")
        check(norm(row["plating"])==("plated" if p["plating"]=="Y" else "nonplated"),run+" "+c["id"]+" plating")
        check(norm(row["hole_type"])==("circledrill" if p["hole"]=="CIRCLE" else "ovalslot"),run+" "+c["id"]+" hole type")
        check(near(num(row["drill_x"]),p["drill"][0]) and near(num(row["drill_y"]),p["drill"][1]),run+" "+c["id"]+" padstack-local drill X/Y")
        if p["hole"]=="CIRCLE":check(near(num(row["drill_diameter"]),p["drill"][0]),run+" "+c["id"]+" round diameter")
    check(seen=={c["id"] for c in spec["cases"]},run+" all cases seen")
    etch=["ETCH/TOP","ETCH/BOTTOM"] if run=="reopen_package" else ["ETCH/TOP","ETCH/L2","ETCH/L3","ETCH/BOTTOM"]
    check(len(padrows)==6*(len(etch)*4+4),run+" all pad layer/type queries recorded")
    for row in padrows:
        c,p=case_for(row)
        if c is None:check(False,run+" unknown pad row");continue
        layer=row["layer"]
        xy=p["mask"] if "SOLDERMASK" in layer else None if "PASTEMASK" in layer else dim(row["kind"],p)
        check(expected_figure(row["figure"],xy),run+" "+c["id"]+" "+layer+" "+row["kind"]+" presence")
        if xy is None:
            check(num(row["width"]) in (None,0) and num(row["height"]) in (None,0),run+" "+c["id"]+" "+layer+" absent geometry")
        else:
            expected=list(reversed(xy)) if c["rotation"]%180==90 else xy
            check(near(num(row["width"]),expected[0]) and near(num(row["height"]),expected[1]),run+" "+c["id"]+" "+layer+" "+row["kind"]+" rotated extents")
    for row in psrows:
        p=next((p for p in spec["padstacks"] if p["name"]==row["padstack"].lower()),None)
        check(p is not None,run+" known persisted padstack")
        if p is None:continue
        check(norm(row["plating_api"])==("plated" if p["plating"]=="Y" else "nonplated"),run+" "+p["name"]+" plating API agrees")
        check(numbers(row["drill_offset"])==[0,0],run+" "+p["name"]+" drill offset")
        check(near(num(row["drill_x"]),p["drill"][0]) and near(num(row["drill_y"]),p["drill"][1]),run+" "+p["name"]+" persisted drill axes")
    defaults=set()
    pattern=re.compile(r'DEFAULT_INTERNAL padstack="([^"]+)" kind="([^"]+)" figure=(nil|"[^"]*") bbox=(.*)')
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m=pattern.fullmatch(line)
        if not m:continue
        name,kind,figure,box=m.groups()
        p=next(p for p in spec["padstacks"] if p["name"]==name.lower())
        xy=dim(kind,p)
        defaults.add((name.lower(),kind))
        n=numbers(box)
        if xy is None:
            check(figure in ("nil",'"NULL"'),run+" "+name+" default "+kind+" absent")
        else:
            check(len(n)==4 and near(n[2]-n[0],xy[0]) and near(n[3]-n[1],xy[1]),run+" "+name+" default "+kind+" extents")
    check(len(defaults)==12,run+" default internal all 3x4 kinds")
    for row in polyrows:
        c,p=case_for(row)
        if c is None:check(False,run+" unexpected polygon");continue
        n=numbers(row["bbox"])
        xy=list(reversed(p["regular"])) if c["rotation"]%180==90 else p["regular"]
        check(len(n)==4 and near(n[2]-n[0],xy[0]) and near(n[3]-n[1],xy[1]),run+" "+c["id"]+" world polygon extents "+row["layer"])
        if len(n)==4:check(near((n[2]+n[0])/2,c["xy"][0]) and near((n[3]+n[1])/2,c["xy"][1]),run+" "+c["id"]+" world polygon center")
    check(len(polyrows)==6*len(etch),run+" one regular polygon per pin per copper layer")
    if run=="reopen_board":
        conductors=[r["name"] for r in stack if r["name"] in ("TOP","L2","L3","BOTTOM")]
        check(conductors==spec["boardConductorLayers"],run+" TOP-L2-L3-BOTTOM order")
    launch=json.loads((d/"launch.json").read_text())
    check(launch["completed"] and launch["exitCode"]==0,run+" native normal exit")
    check(launch["readonlyHashUnchanged"] is True,run+" readonly hash unchanged")
    summary[run]={"pins":len(pinrows),"padRows":len(padrows),"polygons":len(polyrows),"stackRows":len(stack)}
for name in [p["name"] for p in spec["padstacks"]]:
    log=root/"logs"/("import_"+name)
    import_text=(log/"import.log").read_text()
    check(not re.search(r"\b(?:Warning|Error)-",import_text,re.I),name+" accepted import log has no warnings/errors")
result={
    "lesson":7,"date":"2026-10-18","status":"completed_geometry_and_layer_mapping" if not problems else "partial",
    "allChecksPass":not problems,"checkCount":len(checks),"failures":problems,"summary":summary,
    "scope":"Three accepted educational padstacks and persisted 0/90 degree package/4-layer mapping, not production qualification.",
    "failedVariants":["eda_l07_npth_200","eda_l07_npth_200_ko","eda_l07_npth_200_spot"],
    "notValidated":["Pure no-copper NPTH unattended clean import","Dynamic shape voiding and board-level keepout effect","Negative-plane spoked thermal flash/artwork","Manufacturing drill copper subtraction/output and solderability"],
    "ringMeaning":"Non-plated barrel with nominal copper rings. No plated barrel or interlayer electrical connection inferred.",
    "checks":checks}
(root/"validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!="checks"},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
if problems:sys.exit(1)
